newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks seen opening down after poll.
newsitem.headline: French stocks seen opening down after poll.

text.p: French shares were expected to open lower on Friday, mirroring falls in bond prices and Wall Street stocks, brokers said.
The French financial markets reacted nervously on Thursday afternoon to an IPSOS poll that gave the centre-right coalition a wafer-thin majority in the upcoming parliamentary election.
* The blue-chip CAC-40 index gave up most of its gains to close up 0.24 percent on Thursday.
* The CAC-40 April futures contract traded on GLOBEX was down 15 points at 2,523 at 0725 GMT.
